html_source: Detail of 1906 ordnance survey map held in the National Library of Scotland, with added arrows showing locations of the groups of businesses Bloom walks by on Wellington Quay (green), the hotels at which he considers having a meal (orange), Daly's tobacco shop (red), and the Ormond Hotel (blue). Source: maps.nls.uk.
